description: Export FixMap's evidence-backed Impact Graph, including import direction, routed tests, and repeated co-change relationships, as Mermaid or JSON.

base.description: Base git ref to diff against when diff is not given

diff.description: Git diff spec, such as main...HEAD

exclude.description: Path patterns to leave out of ranking, gitignore-flavored, such as "apps/web" or "docs/**". A .fixmapignore file in the repository is applied as well.

format.description: Output format: mermaid (default) or json, case-insensitive

head.description: Head git ref, defaults to HEAD

issue.description: Issue text, task description, or public GitHub issue URL. A GitHub issue URL supplies the task and infers repo when repo is omitted.

limit.description: Maximum context files to return, 1 to 20, default 8. Lower it when context budget matters: the useful signal is usually the top one to three.

noCache.description: Bypass the exact-state repository scan cache

ref.description: Branch or tag to scan when repo is a remote GitHub URL

repo.description: Local path or public GitHub HTTPS repository URL, defaults to the server working directory. GitHub URLs support issue-only analysis and are removed after scanning.

workingTree.description: Map staged and unstaged tracked changes against HEAD

name: fixmap_graph
title: FixMap graph
